We use the transformer model roberta-base (Liu et al., 2019) from (Wolf et al., 2020), and run each experiment with at least two random seeds and report the average performance. We use AdamW (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2018) optimizer with a learning rate of $1 \times 10^{-5}$ , batch size of 16, and weight decay of $1 \times 10^{-2}$ for all models. The model checkpoint with the best validation accuracy is used for final evaluation. In NLI tasks with a pair of text inputs, the indices of both texts are used. For Ling-CL, we optimize the choice of index importance estimation method and aggregation method. For the baselines, we optimize the parameters of SuperLoss ( $\lambda$ and moving average method), and the two parameters of SL-CL and WR-CL models for each dataset. For the data selection, we use a warm-up period of $20\%$ of the total training iterations.
